description: This file defines the Stream class implementing the StreamInterface, providing methods to manipulate and access PHP stream resources, including reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving metadata.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A PHP stream implementation that provides a wrapper for stream resources, allowing for seamless stream manipulation and integration with PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Stream object wrapping a PHP resource with optional size and metadata parameters.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Automatically closes the stream resource when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, seeking to start if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents from the stream.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying resource from the Stream object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at EOF.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific key if provided.
